jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

Scientists use Claude across the life sciences, from drug discovery and research biology to clinical development and manufacturing. To support that work, Anthropic introduced the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives verified life science professionals access to Claude with a refined set of safeguards that is more permissive for biology-related work. The program is in beta.We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the program of work that expands that access and helps scale it with safety in mind.

Each expansion depends on many teams at once and no single team owns the path end to end. You'll become the single owner of that program, the person who knows what each expansion requires, where every workstream stands, what it is waiting on, and who needs to decide. This is a cross-org execution role, not a research role, and it does not require a life sciences background. LSVP is the starting point, and the scope will grow alongside Anthropic's broader work in the life sciences. Over time, more of the life sciences community can get verified access, and each new expansion takes less bespoke effort than the last.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the program for expanding access to Anthropic's life sciences verification programs: scoping, sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs across safeguards, platform, and product engineering teams
* Scope and drive the cross-org engineering work that each expansion requires, from new plan and account types to new platforms
* Partner with the product manager to turn program goals into a sequenced plan with clear owners and dates
* Drive clarity on data access, retention, and review requirements, and on the changes they require across safeguards, access, and provisioning
* Drive user experience scoping across the Claude product surfaces where the program is available
* Find and remove the technical blockers that keep eligible organizations from accessing life sciences capabilities
* Establish the operating rhythm: a single view of workstreams, owners, dependencies, risks, and status, with planning, escalation paths, and launch coordination across orgs
* Convert recurring efforts into documented, repeatable processes so that each new expansion requires less bespoke coordination

* Have several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs
* Have experience coordinating across multiple engineering teams and organizations simultaneously, including safeguards, platform, and product partners
* Can engage meaningfully with the engineers doing the work, from platform and access systems to product surfaces
* Are highly organized and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively across distributed teams
* Thrive in unstructured environments with a knack for bringing order to chaos and creating clarity in ambiguous situations
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority
* Have worked on cloud or platform programs (preferred but not required)
* Do not need a life sciences background. This is not a research role, and no life sciences experience is required
* Are passionate about Anthropic's mission and interested in the challenges of bringing AI capabilities to the life sciences community safely and reliably

Our mission is to develop therapies that empower the immune system to combat neurodegeneration and our team is focused on developing treatments for some of the most challenging diseases facing our society. By harnessing advancements in genetics, immunology and neuroscience, we are pioneering the development of potential therapies to counteract the devastating progression of neurodegeneration. We are supported in this mission by experienced and accomplished scientists and clinicians, a novel portfolio of programs, leading healthcare investors, and pharma company partners, who share in our commitment to bettering the lives of patients and realizing a world where we make brain disorders history.

Alector is seeking a Senior Associate Scientist, Computational Biology, to join our dynamic team. You will play a key role in advancing our understanding of the biology underlying neurodegenerative diseases, improving our computational pipelines, and supporting the discovery of new therapeutic targets.

In this role, you will analyze and interpret complex biological data, with a particular focus on high-content imaging and cell segmentation, alongside high-dimensional multi-omics datasets. You will collaborate with scientists across R&D to design experiments, analyze results, and translate data into meaningful biological insights, while also helping to modernize our pipelines with emerging AI and machine-learning tools.

### **Key Goals & Accountabilities**

* Advance image-based research! Develop, benchmark, and apply computational methods for high-content imaging, including image segmentation, feature extraction, and quantitative single-cell tracking analysis from a broad variety of samples. Evaluate and integrate deep-learning segmentation approaches to improve accuracy and throughput of our models.

* Modernize our pipelines with AI! Identify, evaluate, and incorporate new AI and machine-learning tools into imaging and multi-omics workflows, improving automation, reproducibility, and the speed of turning raw data into insight.

* Turn complex data into biological insights! Analyze imaging and multi-omics datasets and partner with scientists across R&D to address key biological questions and inform experimental design.

* Make scientific data accessible! Manage and organize data from internal and published studies and develop interactive data-exploration portals for internal use.

* Build efficient and reproducible workflows! Apply best practices in code and data management, including workflow orchestration, version control, and documentation, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

* Communicate findings clearly! Present analytical results in verbal, visual, and written formats to cross-functional audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.

### **Required Qualifications**

* M.S. with at least three years of relevant experience or Ph.D. with at least one year of relevant experience in biotechnology, computational biology, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field.

* Hands-on experience analyzing high-content imaging data, including cell segmentation, feature extraction, and qualification, as well as high-dimensional biological datasets, such as bulk or single-cell RNA sequencing or proteomics.

* Experience applying deep-learning and AI-based methods to image analysis, particularly cell segmentation (e.g., Cellpose, MEDIAR).

* Proficiency in R and Python, including experience with relevant tools and packages such as DESeq2, Seurat, Scanpy, dplyr, and tidyverse for statistical modeling and data analysis.

* Familiarity with shell scripting, version control using Git, and cloud-computing environments such as AWS.

* A fundamental understanding of biology and the ability to apply computational approaches to biological questions.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analyses to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch and interest in evaluating emerging AI tools for biological data analysis.

* Experience building or optimizing image-analysis pipelines for high-content or microscopy data.

* Experience mining and analyzing publicly available biological datasets.

* Experience developing dashboards or interactive visualization tools using Shiny, Dash, or similar platforms.

**Research Technician**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Research Technician with extensive hands-on experience in insect cell culture (Sf9 and Hi5) using the baculovirus expression system and mammalian cell culture across diverse cell lines. The successful candidate will support ongoing structural and functional studies of protein complexes by producing high-quality recombinant proteins in both insect and mammalian systems.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Generate bacterial, insect cell, and mammalian expression constructs (basic molecular cloning techniques required).
* Maintain and passage insect cells (Sf9 and Hi5) and mammalian cell cultures under sterile conditions.
* Generate and amplify recombinant baculoviruses for protein expression in Sf9 and Hi5 cells.
* Transfect and maintain various mammalian cell lines (e.g., HEK293, HTC116, Vero, HeLa) for transient and stable expression.
* Optimize expression protocols for high-yield protein production in both systems.
* Perform small- and large-scale protein expression experiments.
* Harvest cells and assist with downstream, protein purification (modern chromatography methods).
* Perform immunofluorescence microscopy to assess protein localization.
* Conduct SDS-PAGE gel analysis and western blotting, as part of routine experiments.
* Maintain detailed records of all experiments, protocols, and cell line inventories.
* Participate in general lab maintenance (organization, restocking, and generating shared reagents).
* Support researchers with other tasks as needed.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related field.
* 2 years of hands-on experience with Sf9 and/or Hi5 cell culture and baculovirus-based protein expression.
* Proficiency in aseptic technique and routine mammalian cell culture.
* Familiarity with restriction enzyme cloning, western blotting, SDS-PAGE gel analysis, immunofluorescence microscopy, protein purification.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience scaling up insect and/or mammalian cultures using flasks.
* Familiarity with serum-free media, virus titering, and MOI optimization.
* Understanding of basic molecular cloning and transfection techniques.
* Protein purification abilities are a plus but not necessary.
* Prior experience in academic or industrial protein production environments.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume

* Harvest cells and assist with downstream, protein purification (modern chromatography methods).
* Perform immunofluorescence microscopy to assess protein localization.

* Support researchers with other tasks as needed.

* Proficiency in aseptic technique and routine mammalian cell culture.

* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

* Experience scaling up insect and/or mammalian cultures using flasks.
* Familiarity with serum-free media, virus titering, and MOI optimization.
* Understanding of basic molecular cloning and transfection techniques.

* Prior experience in academic or industrial protein production environments.
